core.t: Today go carry one small surprise wey go turn to big smile for your face
Chance dey waka towards your side, you just need make you open your door
The thing wey you begin quietly today go show everybody pepper next month
One small favour wey you do before go come back to you today
Your name don enter one good discussion wey no be you start
Luck don see your passport and e already apply for visa to go meet you
For the place wey you dey expect small tin, big blessing dey hide for there
Today di right bus go collect you on time, and you go land everywhere you dey go fine
Somebody wey you help long time don remember you, good news dey come
Your star dey rise slowly but e dey rise with sense and steady hand
Morning don break, and everything wey e carry na fresh chance for you
Whatever yesterday look like, today dey open clean book for your own story
Hope no dey sleep, e dey just count the days till your own turn
The seed wey you plant for rain day go give you sweet fruit soon
You no done yet, and that one na the best news we get today
One door wey close before don open again, only this time e open wide
New beginning dey knock your door, no mind say you still dey make tea
Even cloud get lining, and today your own go shine like new coin
Tomorrow dey carry chair sit down for your corner, e ready to hold you
When you start to think say road don finish, road dey just learn new turn
Somebody dey smile when dem remember your name, even though you no dey their side
Your kind heart dey attract people wey go water you when you dry
Love dey near you today, e dey find the right street to your house
Make you talk the nice thing wey dey your heart, today na the right day
Friendship wey start today go age like good palm oil, e go better with time
The person wey dey miss you don find small excuse to send you message
Your hug fit fix one person whole week, no underestimate am
Kindness wey you show today go travel far and come back with friends
For the middle of plenty crowd, one person dey grateful say dem born you for this world
Love no dey rush, but today e dey jog towards your direction
The version of you wey dey come go make today version proud
You dey grow even for the days wey you just dey rest, and that one normal
One small lesson today go save you plenty wahala tomorrow
Your courage dey stretch like muscle, today go prove am again
What you no fit do last month go enter your hand like water today
Nobody see the work wey you dey do but heaven no dey sleep
You dey turn page by page, and di story dey sweet pass before
New skill dey follow you like small faithful puppy, feed am well
The thing wey you dey dodge before go stand for you today like open door
Plant small today, harvest big, na the law of your own season
Money side go smile for your matter, small small e go gather like rain for bucket
Your table go spread wider this season, plenty guest go want to sit down
Blessing dey flow from one corner to another, and your name dey on the list
The harvest of your quiet work dey come, and e heavy pass basket
Prosperity dey learn your address, soon e go dey knock without warning
More than you need, less than you expect, na so your year dey shape
One opportunity wey you no even price go pay you back plenty times
Your hand go carry plenty, and your heart go know how to share am
Good things dey pile for your corner like yam for barn, plenty and steady
Increase no dey count speed, e dey count direction, and your direction correct
Today your sense go sharp like new blade, use am cut correct path
The right answer dey already for your chest, e just dey wait for quiet minute
Listen twice before you answer once, wisdom go pay you salary for that one
Old proverb don wake up today to guide your footsteps
You go know the right time to speak and the right time to chop
The question wey you dey avoid na him go open the door for you
Patience and sense dey your side, both of dem hold your hand today
Choice wey you make small today go save your big tomorrows
Experience dey whisper to you today, and na your own voice e dey borrow
Clear head and soft heart go carry you go places wey strong hand no fit reach
Take the step wey your leg dey want to dodge, ground go steady you well
Your dream no get expiry date, today na fine day to start am
Nobody fit tell you say you no fit, especially you the one wey dey always try
Courage no mean say your leg no dey shake, na say e dey shake but e dey march
That big thing wey you dey look from far go become small thing by evening
Your voice get power today, and people go lean their ears come near
Raise your hand for the thing wey you want, heaven dey count raised hands
Wahala come for visit today, e no get appointment to carry you go anywhere
Start where you dey, use wetin you get, and di road go appear as you dey walk
The lion inside you dey stretch e leg today, make you no hold am back
Something small go make you laugh today and you go forget wetin make you frown
Today joy go find you even for queue, e no need your address
Your smile dey do important national service, continue to use am everyday
Good news dey travel with one song wey you love, make you ready to dance small
The way sun shine this morning na for your own celebration
Gratitude dey open plenty door wey complaint no fit find key for
Today fine thing go happen for your area and everybody go hear am
Enjoy the small chops and di bigger ones, both of dem belong to you
Laughter dey plan to visit your house today, make your sitting room warm for am
Your happiness no need big budget, small things dey arrange demself fine
You don survive plenty tough days already, and each one teach you something
This challenge na just stair, and your leg strong pass stair
Whatever bend you today no go break you, na bend make tree no snap
You dey come back stronger, and this time you bring sense with you
Rain go finish, sun go remember your name, na so the sky dey work
The same fire wey burn dry leaf go make your resolve shine like gold
Pick yourself with gentle hands, na champion you dey rebuild
Slow recovery still dey move, and movement na movement
You carry patience like shield and courage like walking stick
Your comeback story go sweet pass the setback, hold your own
New road dey call your name today, no be far, just around one corner
Pack small curiosity for your pocket, adventure like light traveller
One journey wey you dey postpone don reduce e price, today na time
Strange food dey wait to become your new favourite, trust your tongue
Maps dey change for you this week, everywhere you go you go find good shortcut
Today go give you one story wey your grandchildren go love to hear
If you travel with good heart, everybody you meet go become your guide
Di world get plenty open doors, and today one of dem get your name for front
Small detour today go carry you go place wey fine picture dey waka
Go where your feet dey guide, the best view dey always find the brave
Neighbour wey you greet small go remember you when good thing dey share
Your circle dey grow with people wey go clap when you win
Today one hand go extend for you, and another hand go dey your side
Community of good people dey gather for your corner, you just dey reach
When you share your bread, your pot go find extra pot
Somebody wey you never meet go speak well of you today
Together dey easy, and today your people dey ready to waka with you
The village wey support you dey bigger than you think, your people plenty
Your gift go meet person wey need am exact today, no doubt am
Good company dey your future like shade for hot afternoon, enjoy the cool
Your mind dey find quiet like river wey don see the sea
Today go come soft, dey go soft, and finish soft
Peace dey your pocket like small smooth stone, touch am whenever you need
Breathe in calm, breathe out rush, and your day go balance itself
Nothing fit disturb the corner of your heart wey you already tidy
Rest no be reward, na luggage for the journey, pack am well
Your heart get sense, today e dey speak and everybody go hear
Slow water sweet, and your own dey pour gentle and steady
Make peace with yesterday, am and today don already shake hand for you
Quiet joy dey come like evening breeze, just open your window small
The universe dey shuffle deck for you today, and your cards dey look fine
Even the longest night dey carry sunrise inside im pocket
The way you take care of people go come back to you with interest
Your head dey grow pass the hat wey people give you, keep learning
Season of plenty dey knock, make you find bigger pot for your kitchen
Two ears and one mouth, use dem in that proportion today and you go win
Begin with shaking voice, the song go steady himself along the way
One small dance for kitchen this morning go set the tone for the whole day
The rope wey tie you before don turn to rope for jumping games
Put on your travelling slippers, even the street wey you know go show you new face
Your small contribution go enter the big pot of your people and sweet am
Like hammock for veranda, today dey invite you to swing slow

openings: Your morning start with one good news
Today wake up and e dey look you well well
Sun don rise and e carry fresh chance for your hand
Di day begin soft, like fresh bread wey dem just cut
Open your eye, today get your own name for front
Something nice dey follow you from yesterday, e just reach today
Today na small festival for your life, no be birthday but e dey look like am
Di air for your street today carry good favour
Your day open like market wey full of sweet option
Before you even finish your tea, blessing don start to arrange itself
Di moon do im best last night make you fit sleep well, now morning take over
Di road wey you dey avoid before go greet you today like old friend
Your name dey on good luck tongue this morning
One door wey you knock before don finally hear you
Di week don turn to your side, and e dey smile
Today even the birds dey sing with your own melody
Something wey you forget don come back to make you happy
Good thing dey do warm up exercise for your area
Di morning dew dey wash your way clean for today
Today you go need only half of the plan, di other half na pure blessing
Di sun don put on e best colour just for your opening scene
Make you wash your face, put on confidence, today dey wait for you
One fine surprise don enter your day without appointment
Today your pocket, your heart and your mind go dey in one agreement
Di day wey you dey pray for don finally show up
Your morning light, your path clear, your heart light
Today no be ordinary day, e dey carry special delivery
Even the wind dey push your back for the right direction
Fine thing dey gather for your corner like rain cloud wey ready to bless
Your day start fine, and e no plan to stop fine
Di clock don strike for your own time to shine
Something good dey boil for pot, e just need small patience
Today favour go dey your front and rear
New day don land, and na you be the VIP
Di sky write one good sentence for you this morning
Today laughter dey your side like old friendship
Everybody wey love you dey root for you this morning
Your day dey open like fresh page, and pen dey your hand
Good luck dey jog towards your house, e no dey far
Today the good side of life dey take you on tour
themes: Small steps today go carry you go far tomorrow
Wetin you plant for quiet go shout for public
One good turn dey collect another good turn, and dem go visit you together
Your consistency dey build one strong house wey rain no fit shake
Count your blessings small small, dem go multiply like fish for net
Learn something small today and keep am for your back pocket
Patience and hustle dey dance together for your matter
Good people dey come and careless schedule dey go
Your heart get compass, e know the road to good thing
When you share, your store dey grow instead of reduce
Courage no dey shout, e just dey take the next step
Your good name be your best account for this world
Every effort dey count, even the ones wey nobody see
Di right time dey prepare itself while you dey work
Small rest dey turn tired person to fresh champion
When you speak good word, you dey plant garden wey everybody go sit for
Your story still dey write, and di best chapter dey near
Humble people dey collect wisdom like plenty water
One honest word today go save ten excuse tomorrow
Opportunities like early bus, dem dey collect the ones wey dey there
Your dream deserve one small schedule, give am date and time
What you dey give freely go come back with interest
Di tree wey bend dey survive storm, your softness na strength
Listen well, answer better, and people go respect your voice
Progress no need to loud, e just need to steady
Two small good habits go chop one big wahala
When you lift one person, your own height dey increase
Your season no dey compete with anybody else own
Use your head, but no forget to carry your heart
Good question dey open door wey right answer no fit knock
Every challenge dey carry envelope, open am you find lesson inside
Your table go bigger, your heart go softer, your load go lighter
Faith without work na song without drum, so keep both of dem
A calm head dey choose better than fast hand
Blessing dey flow to the place wey gratitude dey stay
Make your yes mean yes, and make your no protect your peace
Di world dey reward people wey start before dem ready
Little by little, bird build im nest and fly far
New skill for your hand na key for new room
When you do good, goodness dey learn your address
Your body dey carry strength wey you no yet use, save am for today
Make you look up, your horizon don widen since last week
The hand wey dey give dey always dry faster than the one wey dey hold
Tomorrow dey borrow strength from wetin you do today
closings: Your day go wrap with sweet smile
Good news go reach you before evening
Blessing go dey your front, and peace go dey your back
You go sleep tonight with light heart
Everything wey suppose sweet you today go sweet you
Hold your own, your time dey shine
Today go end like fine song wey everybody enjoy
Good thing dey come, and e no dey late
Your cup go full, e go even overflow small
Na so, the good life dey your side
Walk your own walk, your road dey clap for you
Today go obey you, and e go obey you well
Make sweet mouth follow you everywhere you step
Your joy no get expiry, e dey just keep renewing
Di best for today dey still come, but even di rest fine
Go and collect wetin dey your name today
Your day go finish soft like pillow wey happy person sleep on
One more good thing dey your pocket already
Nothing fit spoil today for you, e too fine for that
You too much, and today go agree with you
Fine person like you no dey miss good day
Keep shining, your light dey show other people road
Today go write you for good book
Every step you take today go bless you back
Your people go proud of you before night fall
Small happiness go find you, big one dey trail am
Enjoy today well well, na your own portion be that
Your name go come up for good place today
Peace go sit for your house like family
Today your smile go cost nothing but e go worth plenty
Good wind dey push your boat, make you just steer
Tomorrow go meet you with full belly and soft bed
Di good thing wey you dey carry, e go land today
Your day go close like golden evening, warm and sweet
